target: AArch64 native ZealC/QEMU guest with PCI VirtIO-net and QEMU user networking

checks.network_stack: PASS: native VirtIO-net initialized and DHCP configured 10.0.2.15
checks.listen: PASS: TCPChatServer reached Socket now listening on a guest port forwarded from the host
checks.accept: PASS: the host connected through QEMU user-network host forwarding and the guest accepted the client
checks.broadcast: PASS: host sent ARM64 TCP chat payload probe and received the same payload in the server broadcast
checks.runtime_health: PASS: guest returned to a healthy command session after the exchange

arm64_adaptations: TCP listen backlog uses QueueCount, which matches backlog semantics and is available in the ARM64 bootstrap; QueueSize measured allocation bytes and was not exported.
TCPChatServer initializes globals when loaded with CCF_JUST_LOAD and checks heap pointers against NULL rather than signed integer positivity.
TCPChatServer extracts the peer IPv4 address through a typed pointer to the inline sockaddr storage.
scope_note: This verifies one client accept, greeting, payload receive, and self-broadcast in QEMU user networking. It does not verify multiple clients, UTM networking, arbitrary external interfaces, or the other TCP/UDP clients.
